leadText:
Jimmy Ray (Japanese: ヨシヒコ Yoshihiko) is a minor recurring character in .

He debuted in Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!, where he participated in the Club Battle tournament and was 's first opponent. His most notable feature is the costume he wears. Not much is known about him as he is defeated by Iris in the first round during Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!, and thus knocked out of the tournament.

==Pokémon==
 
 

Jimmy Ray has at least two other Pokémon as those who entered the Club Battle were required to enter with three Pokémon.

==Pokémon competitions==

Club Battle - Top 16 (Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!)
